name: labs/squad-lab__qcdrivers
title: SQUAD Lab AD75019 crosspoint switch (qcdrivers Muxi)
intro: SQUAD Lab AD75019 crosspoint switch (qcdrivers Muxi), adapted from squad-lab/qcdrivers. It reads `identity`; runs `connect`, `status` and `reset_matrix`. `connect`: close one crosspoint with SWITCH32 x,y and read it back with STAT? x,y. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/squad-lab__qcdrivers --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/squad-lab__qcdrivers --backend fake --mcp
